bottleneck.description: Dominant supplier of high-purity contamination-control consumables (filters, FOUPs, liquid delivery, CMP slurries, advanced deposition materials) with single-sourced positions on multiple advanced-node process steps.

dependency.key_customers: TSMC, Samsung, Intel, SK Hynix, Micron, GlobalFoundries (all major foundries/IDMs)
dependency.key_suppliers: Specialty resins, fluoropolymers, high-purity chemicals, internal fabrication; CMC Materials acquisition broadened internal sourcing

editorial.notes: Entegris holds 35-40% share in microcontamination control and is single-sourced on several advanced-node process consumables (fluoropolymer filters, FOUPs, certain CMP slurries). Content-per-wafer rises with node scaling, deepening lock-in. CHIPS Act funding ($75M memorandum) for Colorado Springs facility underlines US-strategic positioning. While competition exists from Pall, Merck KGaA, and CMC peers in some segments, qualification cycles and node-specific lock-ins justify HIGH.
